It enables various malicious capabilities such as uploading/downloading files, modifying registry keys, loading DLLs into memory, and running shell commandsall while maintaining stealth. DESCRIPTION (ABSTRACT): Glupteba is a sophisticated trojan horse malware and backdoor trojan, identified as one of the top ten malware variants of 2021, which infects systems to deliver additional malware, collect user authentication data, and integrate compromised devices into a crypto-mining botnet. It propagates primarily through Pay-Per-Install networks, infected installers, and software cracks, additionally employing modules to exploit vulnerabilities in various Internet of Things (IoT) devices. A unique characteristic of Glupteba is its method of distributing Command and Control (C2) domains by embedding AES-encrypted addresses within the Bitcoin blockchain, offering significant resistance to takedown attempts due to the irreversible nature of blockchain transactions.
